index.title: Tic-Tac-Toe Online — Multiplayer Browser Game | Hackatoa
index.description: Play Tic-Tac-Toe online against a friend in real time. Classic 3-in-a-row strategy in your browser — no signup, no download, instant play. Free multiplayer game.
index.tagline: Play Tic Tac Toe with a friend or challenge the AI!

seo.intro: Tic-Tac-Toe Online is a free, browser-based version of the classic three-in-a-row game (also known as noughts and crosses). Challenge a friend to a real-time online multiplayer match by sharing a link, or play solo against the computer AI. There is no sign-up and no download — it plays instantly on desktop and mobile.
howToSteps: Choose a mode — Play vs Friend for online multiplayer, or Play vs AI for a solo game.
Invite a friend — for multiplayer, share the game link that is created. You both join the same board.
Take turns — players alternate placing X and O on the 3×3 grid.
Get three in a row — line up three of your marks horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.
features: Real-time online multiplayer — play a friend live by sharing a link.
Single-player vs AI — practice against the computer any time.
Free and instant — no account, no install, no download required.
Plays anywhere — works in any modern browser on desktop, phone, or tablet.

faqs.q: Is Tic-Tac-Toe Online free to play?
faqs.a: Yes. It is completely free with no sign-up, no ads, and no download — just open the page and play.

faqs.q: Can I play Tic-Tac-Toe online with a friend?
faqs.a: Yes. Click Play vs Friend to create a game, then share the link. You both play in real time on the same board.

faqs.q: Can I play Tic-Tac-Toe against the computer?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Play vs AI to play a solo game against the computer opponent right in your browser.

faqs.q: Do I need to download or install anything?
faqs.a: No. It runs entirely in your web browser on desktop and mobile — there is nothing to download or install.
